assumptions: Each enzyme's recognition site and cut offsets are REBASE's, as the bundled table holds them.
The molecule's topology is as the record states, so a site across the origin of a circular one is found.
limits: Cut positions only: methylation blocks and star activity are check_methylation_block's and find_star_sites' questions.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where do these enzymes cut this molecule, on which strand, and what end does each cut leave?

description: Cut positions of the given enzymes on the open plasmid (top/bottom cut, overhang, kind).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

enzymes.description: enzyme names to scan for — resolved against the bundled cut catalog (REBASE spellings; smaller than the REBASE dossier the editor shows), e.g. EcoRI, BsaI. Left unset, the run uses your active enzyme collection.

name: find_restriction_sites
